item.title: Kansas Connections Academy opens enrollment for the 2026-27 school year
item.description: ELKHART – Kansas Connections Academy, a tuition-free, full-time online public school, is now enrolling students in grades K-12 for the 2026-27 school year. With more than 15 years of experience, the school offers an established education program to more than 1,300 students across Kansas.
